_meta_itemized.wave: itemized-vision(claude-opus-5; 2026-08-14 summit scan tranche, Phase B)

contributions.detail: exact - 17 rows sum to 7,998.33 = the cover's contribution figure (current_report and cumulative_totals both 7,998.33; last_report printed 'N/A'). The page prints no total of its own. Specimen row $435.00 excluded.

expenditures.detail: DELTA of 300.17. The 35 transcribed rows (31 on p3, 4 on p4) sum to 8,265.98; the cover states 7,965.81. Neither expense page prints its own section total, so the cover is the only stated figure. The four struck amount cells were read with their handwritten right-margin corrections governing (503.77, 79.17, 1014.71, 58.60); using the struck figures instead would move the sum FURTHER from the cover (about 8,384.83), so the delta is not a struck-vs-corrected choice. No subset of the transcribed rows sums to 300.17. Corroborating evidence that the filer's own arithmetic is loose: the cover's stated contributions minus its stated expenditures is 32.52, but the cover states a campaign balance of 35.52. Published with both figures named per the section-total gate.

_meta_itemized.page_gates: p2 ITEMIZED CONTRIBUTION REPORT (handwritten on the county's 2022 form) prints NO section total of its own; the gate is the cover's contribution figure 7,998.33, which the 17 real rows reproduce TO THE CENT (including the odd 333.33 row that makes the cents work). The form's SPECIMEN row - '04/15/20 Jon & Jane Doe, P.O. Box 128, Coalville, UT, 84017, $435.00', printed in a grey band - is dropped; with it the side would be 8,433.33. pp3-4 ITEMIZED EXPENSE REPORT: p3 is the county form (hand-titled 'PAGE 1/2', specimen row '04/15/20 Name of Business / Campaign signs & flyers / $512.00' dropped) and p4 is the filer's own hand-ruled continuation on notebook paper ('PAGE 2/2'). NEITHER expense page prints a section total, so the only gate is the cover's 7,965.81 - and the 35 rows sum to 8,265.98, a delta of 300.17 that no single re-read resolves. Every amount was re-read at 700-900 dpi in tight crops (both halves of p3's Amount column, the four struck cells and their margin corrections, p3's top block and its below-the-grid overflow, and all of p4); the column has 31 amounts on p3 and 4 on p4 against exactly 31 and 4 names and 31 and 4 purposes, so no row is missing or doubled. The COVER ITSELF DOES NOT CLOSE: 7,998.33 - 7,965.81 = 32.52 while the cover states a campaign balance of 35.52, a 3.00 internal inconsistency independent of this transcription. The expenditure side is therefore published with BOTH figures named and result='delta' - the filer's arithmetic is a fact about the document.

_meta_itemized.notes: Holly McClure, County Council Seat D, 2022 Pre-Election. 4 pages: p1 cover, p2 handwritten contributions on the county's 2022 form, p3 handwritten expenses on the county form (hand-labelled PAGE 1/2), p4 a hand-ruled continuation on notebook paper (PAGE 2/2, with three-hole punch marks). No embedded text layer; every ledger page read full-page at 200 dpi and then escalated with tight crops. ADDRESSES ARE REDACTED BY THE COUNTY: on p2 the Mailing Address and Zip Code cells of all seventeen real donor rows are erased, leaving broken residual strokes, while the printed specimen row's 'P.O. Box 128, Coalville, UT / 84017' survives untouched - a redaction applied to real donors only. donor_city/donor_state are therefore honestly BLANK on every row. SOURCE PROPERTIES worth recording: (a) the filer's HANDWRITING RUNS LOW - on both p3 and p4 the Person/Organization name for a row is written about one line below that row's Purpose and Amount, so a naive read pairs each vendor with the previous row's purpose; the pairing here is by order and is confirmed by tight crops at three points on p3 ('SIGNS.COM' with 'YARD SIGNS' 679.90, 'MC EMBROIDERY LLC' with 'T-SHIRTS FOR SUMMIT COUNTY FAIR' 195.32, 'STAPLES' with 'BID PHOTOCOPIES - GOP CAUCUS' 82.59) and by the counts matching column for column. (b) FOUR amount cells on p3 are struck through with a handwritten correction in the right margin joined by a line or arrow; the corrections govern. (c) The filer RAN OUT OF RULED ROWS on p3 and wrote the last three expenses freehand BELOW the grid's bottom rule. (d) Small circled marks in p3's right margin next to several rows are the filer's own check marks, not amounts. GEOMETRY: p2's and p3's vertical rules are not detected (rowbands returns no column rules on either), so the record supplies x/w for both sides while the row bands stay MEASURED where the printed grid was detected. Contributions: p2's 19 uniform detected bands are the form's own rows and the 17 data rows are bands 10-26 (verified: band 10 -> '5/11/22 SUMMIT GOP $500.00', band 26 -> '10/20/22 JENNIFER BEVILAGUA 300.00'). Expenditures: p3's 27 detected bands cover data rows 2-28 (band 1 -> the STAPLES row, band 27 -> the UPRINTING row), so those 27 rows are MEASURED; the four rows the printed grid does not cover - p3's first row and its three below-the-grid overflow rows - plus p4's four rows are carried on a DECLARED frame (pitch 2.434 fitted through them; band 28 -> p3 row 1, bands 44-46 -> p3 rows 29-31, bands 24-27 -> p4 rows 1-4, each verified by crop at 500 dpi). Escalations: 6 tight crops at 500-900 dpi.
